title: Flatten Matrix Rows
goal: Extract all positive numbers from a two-dimensional grid into a flat vector.
hints: row.iter() returns an iterator. map would yield an iterator of iterators.
take_while stops at the first element that fails the condition. filter keeps searching.
explanation: flat_map maps each row to an iterator and flattens the result into a single stream of references. map leaves the stream as an iterator of iterators, causing type mismatch E0308 in downstream calls. filter inspects every element, whereas take_while aborts early on the first negative number and ignores remaining rows.
